Jeremy — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can support a 12-month+ immutable retention window and automate evidence exports. Longer answer below with an operational runbook and a proposal for the capacity uplift.

Runbook (high level):
- Scope: audit logs, system events (auth, admin, config), and API request traces.
- Delivery: automated S3-compatible export (encrypted at rest) on a daily cadence, with an on-demand immediate export if requested.
- Retention: default 12 months immutable; option to extend to 24 months for an add-on.
- Chain of custody: checksums + signed manifest for each export (we can provide CSV manifest).
- Onboarding: a 2-week dry run where we deliver daily exports to your staging bucket and confirm parsing/ingestion.

Cost/Capacity note: to support 2.5x peak throughput we recommend a staged onramp (30% -> 60% -> 100% over 6 weeks) so we can tune batching and caching. Roughly, that maps to a Dedicated capacity uplift estimate + a one-time migration coordination fee. Kimberly will send numbers.

I've attached a starter manifest that lists the file groups and naming conventions. If the proposed time works, we can use the call to finalize SLA language and procurement steps.

Attaching: SOC2_evidence_manifest.csv, redwood-security-shared-playbook.md

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Jeremy / Ben — adding the cost and timeline detail. Quick bullets: 
- 12-month immutable retention: included in Enterprise tier with small uptick for storage growth; no procurement lead time.
- 24-month option: +$0.015 per GB/month (estimated $2,100/mo at current ingestion rates).
- Capacity uplift to 2.5x peak: recommended path = Dedicated pool (reserved commit) + autoscale headroom. Estimated delta = $12,000/month on top of current committed spend; one-time onramp fee = $4,200 to cover operational tuning and the dry-run exports.
- SLA amendment: add a retention appendix and an evidence delivery SLO (daily export + 95% success rate).

We can provide a formal quote after the call. For the dry run we need one staging S3 bucket and an engineer-contact at StellarBank to validate manifests.
